verses: Aik sawal kerney walay ney uss azab ka sawal kiya jo wazeh honey wala hai
Kafiron per, jissay koi hataney wala nahi
Uss Allah ki taraf say jo seerhiyon wala hai
Jiss ki taraf farishtay aur rooh charhtay hain aik din mein jiss ki miqdaar pachas hazar saal ki hai
Pus to achi tarah sabar ker
Be-shak yeh uss (azab) ko door samajh rahey hain
Aur hum ussay qareeb hi dekhtay hain
Jiss din aasman misil tel ki talchat kay ho jaye ga
Aur pahar misil rangeen oon kay ho jayen gay
Aur koi dost kissi dost ko na poochay ga
(halankay) aik doosray ko dikha diye jayen gay, gunehgar uss din kay azab kay badlay fidye mein apney beton ko
Apni biwi ko aur apney bhai ko
Aur apney kunbay ko jo ussay panah deta tha
Aur aur zamin kay sab logon ko dena chahaye ga takay yeh ussay nijat dila dey
(magar) hergiz yeh na hoga, yaqeenan woh shola wali (aag) hai
Jo mun aur sir ki khal khench laney wali hai
Woh her uss shakhs ko pukaray gi jo peechay hata aur mun morta hai
Aur jama kerkay samnbhal rakhta hai
Be-shak insan baray kachy dil wala banaya gaya hai
Jab ussay museebat phonchti hai to harbara uthta hai
Aur jab rahat milti hai to bukhul kerney lagta hai
Magar woh namazi
Jo apni namaz per hameshgi kerney walay hain
Aur jin kay maalon mein muqarrara hissa hai
Mangney walon ka bhi aur sawal say bachney walon ka bhi
Aur jo insaf kay din per yaqeen rakhtay hain
Aur jo apney rab kay azab say dartay rehtay hain
Be-shak unn kay rab ka azab bey khof honey ki cheez nahi
Aur jo log apni sharm gahaon ki (haram say) hifazat kertay hain
Haan unn ki biwiyon aur londiyon kay baray mein jin kay woh malik hain unhen koi malamat nahi
Abb jo koi uss kay alawa (raah) ilawa(rah)dhonday ga to aisay log hadd say guzar janey walay hun gay
Aur jo apni amanaton ka aur apney qol o qarar ka pass rakhtay hain
Aur jo apni gawahion per seedhay aur qaeem rehtay hain
Aur jo apni namazon ki hifazat kertay hain
Yehi log jannaton mein izzat walay hun gay
Pus kafiron ko kiya ho gaya hai kay woh teri taraf dortay aatay hain
Dayen aur bayen say giroh kay giroh
Kiya unn mein say her aik ki tawaqqa yeh hai kay woh nematon wali jannat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga?
(aisa) hergiz na hoga. Hum ney unhen uss (cheez) say peda kiya hai jissay woh jantay hain
Pus mujhay qasam hai mashriqon aur maghribon kay rab ki (kay) hum yaqeenan qadir hain
Uss per kay unn kay ewaz unn say achay log ley aayen aur hum aajiz nahi hain
Pus to unhen jhagarta khelata chor dey yahan tak kay yeh apney uss din say jamilein jiss ka unn say wada kiya jata hai
Jiss din yeh qabron say dortay huye niklen gay, goya kay woh kissi jagah ki taraf tez tez jaa rahey hain
Unn ki aankhen jhuki hui hun gi, unn per zillat cha rahi hogi, yeh hai woh din jiss ka unn say wada kiya jata tha
